The '''QuickSnap 36T/I''' was a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] manufactured by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]]. It was not as powerful as SoroSuub's [[QuickSnap 36T]], but cost the same.
